thread:
Alex: Heads-up — docs PR #2345 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready but the preview keeps failing and it's blocking the release cutoff. Anyone free to help triage?
Jamie: I can look in 10. Is this the FF-gated preview?
Alex: Yep, preview job errors with a route 404 when it tries to fetch the versioned sidebar. Build log: 
Alex: ```
err: fetch /docs/v2.3/sidebar.json -> 404
stack: preview-generator failed to hydrate nav
```
Morgan: Sounds like the versioned docs generation didn't pick up the new sidebar entry. Did the PR update docs-config.yaml?
Alex: I updated docs-config.yaml and added the migration page under /v2.3/, plus an SDK snippet in /snippets/js/auth.md. CI shows the files present in the artifact.
Sam: CI-bot shows preview-gen ran on an older commit for some reason. Maybe the canary builder picked a different base branch. CC @CI-bot to confirm.
CI-bot: preview-generator triggered for commit 9f3a2b7 on branch release/v2.3. Status: failure. Artifact: https://ci.internal/artefacts/9f3a2b7/preview.tar.gz
Tia: If the artifact contains the files, could it be the routing table mismatch? We landed a change in runtime that names the sidebar `v2_3` instead of `v2.3` earlier this week.
Jamie: Good catch. That naming change is behind FF `docs_new_sidebar_naming` — is that flagged on the preview workers?
Alex: I didn't think to toggle the FF on preview. The PR is docs-only so we assumed preview would still work.
Morgan: Two options: flip the FF for the preview run (fast) or rename the sidebar key in the PR to the alternate name (safe but invasive). Which do we prefer given the cutoff?
Sam: Since cutoff is in 6 hours, flipping the FF for the preview job is quickest. If QA gives thumbs, we can merge and then open a follow-up to normalize naming across versions.
Tia: I can flip the FF for the preview cluster, but it'll need Ops approval for infra changes. @Deploy-bot can you open a quick toggle request?
Deploy-bot: Infra toggle request opened: TICKET-8721. Change: enable `docs_new_sidebar_naming` on preview-cluster for 2 hours. Reviewer: infra-oncall. ETA: 25m.
Jamie: While we wait, Alex can you add a tiny fallback in the preview generator to accept both `v2.3` and `v2_3`? A one-line try/fallback would avoid these gates in future.
Alex: I can add it but it'll require a quick runtime patch and another preview rebuild — might add 40m. Leaning to toggling FF now.
Morgan: Agreed. Toggle now, QA run in ~30m, if green we merge. If not green, revert and try the runtime patch.
CI-bot: preview-generator retriggered (after FF toggle). Build 9f3a2b7-2 queued.
Alex: Thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and will post the QA link when ready.
Sam: If QA signs off, can we merge with `docs-only` label and bypass the usual canary hold? We need to ensure Release Engineering knows this is docs-only and safe.
Tia: I'll ping release-eng on the ticket and ask for an expedited approval for docs-only items.
Jamie: QA link: https://preview.internal/9f3a2b7-2/docs/v2.3/migration. Looks good to me, sidebar appears and snippets render.
Alex: Verified also — examples render, code blocks highlight. Ready to merge once release-eng ok. :thumbsup:
Deploy-bot: TICKET-8721 updated: infra-oncall approved, toggle applied. Revert scheduled in 2h.
Sam: Merging now. Tagging in release-eng: @release-eng please accept docs-only merge for PR #2345 ahead of cutoff.
Morgan: If release-eng pushes back, we can hold the merge behind the flag until after the cut, but good to try now.
Alex: Merge done — PR #2345 merged to main at 2147654390. Thanks team.
Jamie: Nice. Follow-up: open a small cleanup PR to unify naming and add unit test for sidebar lookup.
Alex: Filed PR #2370 for naming cleanup.
Sam: Great work — saved the cutoff. :tada:
